newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ex-head of Mexico's Grupo Televisa dies.
newsitem.headline: Ex-head of Mexico's Grupo Televisa dies.

text.p: Mexican media giant Grupo Televisa said Wednesday Emilio Azcarraga Milmo, the powerful ex-chairman who recently stepped down due to ill health, had died.
The 66-year-old billionaire, who during two decades at its helm built Televisa into the Spanish speaking world's largest media firm, died in Florida, Televisa said in its 24 Horas nightly bulletin.
His body was due to be flown back to Mexico for burial.
Televisa gave no details of the cause of death, but anchorman Jacobo Zabludovsky expressed the firm's condolences to the family. Azcarraca Milmo was believed to have had a brain tumour.

Azcarraga Milmo resigned on March 4, to be replaced by his 29-year-old son Emilio Azcarraga Jean as president and chief executive officer, and Guillermo Canedo White, as chairman and chief corporate officer.
